new.content: Skip to content Home > Lokesh Dipak Jahure: From BCA & 2-Year Career Gap to Robotics Solution Associate at Verificient Lokesh Dipak Jahure: From BCA & 2-Year Career Gap to Robotics Solution Associate at Verificient What changed in Lokesh’s career after a 2-year gap? Read how his Full Stack Java learning journey through Java Classes in Pune helped him move toward a Robotics Solution Associate role at Verificient Technologies. Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 22, 2026 5:30 pm Introduction Lokesh Dipak Jahure , a BCA graduate from the 2024 batch , wanted to strengthen his programming knowledge with practical skills that could support his transition into the IT industry. However, a two-year gap after graduation made the journey more challenging. Instead of allowing the gap to define his career path, Lokesh decided to use this period as an opportunity to strengthen his technical skills and prepare himself for the changing demands of the IT sector. His turning point came when he joined the Full Stack Java program at 3RI Technologies . The structured training gave him an opportunity to move beyond academic concepts and work on programming, databases, web technologies, Java, frameworks, and practical projects. With the skills developed during his training and his continued efforts toward employment, Lokesh eventually secured an opportunity at Verificient Technologies as a Robotics Solution Associate . His journey from a BCA graduate with a two-year gap to a technology professional highlights an important lesson for fresh graduates and jobseekers: a career gap does not have to be the end of the journey. With focused learning, practical exposure, and consistent effort, it can become a phase of preparation for the next career step. The Challenge After completing his BCA in 2024, Lokesh Dipak Jahure faced a challenging phase in his career journey. A two-year gap after graduation made it harder for him to confidently approach the IT job market, and he knew that simply having a degree was not enough to stand out. He wanted to rebuild his t echnical foundation, improve his programming and problem-solving abilities, and gain practical experience with Java, databases, and web technologies . While exploring Java Classes in Pune , Lokesh found the structured learning environment at 3RI Technologies helpful in turning his time away from the industry into a period of focused skill development. Through practical exercises, project work, and step-by-step guidance , he worked on strengthening the areas where he lacked confidence. Rather than treating his career gap as a setback, Lokesh used it as an opportunity to learn, practice, and prepare himself for his next professional step. The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies For Lokesh, joining 3RI Technologies was an opportunity to rebuild his technical skills in a structured way after his two-year career gap. The 5-month Full Stack Java training gave him time to move gradually from programming fundamentals to web and application development. The program includes 10 real-time projects , allowing learners to apply concepts through hands-on work instead of relying only on classroom theory. For Lokesh, exploring Java Courses in Pune meant finding a learning path where different technical skills could come together and support his preparation for an IT career.During the training, Lokesh worked across several important areas: Programming foundations: He strengthened his understanding of programming concepts, object-oriented programming, and problem-solving. Core Java and web development: His learning covered Core Java along with JDBC, JSP, and Servlets to understand how Java is used in application development. Backend technologies: Spring and Hibernate introduced him to frameworks used for building and managing Java-based applications. Database skills: MySQL and SQL helped him understand how applications store, retrieve, and work with data. Front-end development: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript provided the foundation for creating and working with web interfaces. Practical project work: The 10 real-time projects gave him opportunities to practice concepts and build hands-on experience. Career preparation: Communication skills, aptitude, interview preparation, portfolio development, certification, and job assistance formed part of the broader career-focused learning process. Email Phone Send The Learning Path of Java Classes in Pune Lokesh’s learning journey at 3RI Technologies progressed step by step, helping him strengthen his technical skills after a two-year career gap. Starting with the basics and gradually moving toward Java application development, each stage gave him an opportunity to understand and practise a new area of technology. Weeks 1–4 – Building the Foundation: He began with programming fundamentals, computer concepts, OOP, operating systems, networking, and Linux. Weeks 5–8 – Working with Databases: He developed a practical understanding of MySQL, SQL queries, joins, database design, and data handling. Weeks 9–12 – Exploring Web Development: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript helped him build a foundation in web development. Weeks 13–16 – Deepening Java Skills: He progressed through Core Java, exception handling, collections, I/O, and multithreading. Weeks 17–20 – Moving Towards Application Development: He worked with JDBC, JSP, Servlets, Spring, Hibernate, and project-based development. This gradual learning process helped Lokesh connect his technical knowledge with practical application. After completing his training and continuing his efforts toward his career goals, he secured an opportunity at Verificient Technologies as a Robotics Solution Associate . For someone returning to the job market after a two-year gap, reaching this professional milestone marked an important step forward in his IT journey. The Outcome of Java Courses in Pune For Lokesh, the Full Stack Java training at 3RI Technologies was an important step in rebuilding his technical confidence after a two-year gap. The course gave him exposure to programming, databases, web technologies, Java development, and practical application, helping him prepare for opportunities in the IT sector.After completing his training and continuing his efforts toward his career goals, Lokesh also benefited from Placement support that helped him move closer to opportunities in the IT industry. His journey can be summarized as: BCA (2024) → Two-year career gap → Full Stack Java training → Practical skill development → Career preparation → Robotics Solution Associate at Verificient Technologies Area Lokesh’s Journey Education BCA, 2024 Training Full Stack Java Practical exposure Java, databases, web technologies and project work Career progression Continued skill development after a two-year gap Professional outcome Robotics Solution Associate at Verificient Technologies After completing his training and continuing his efforts to enter the IT industry, Lokesh secured an opportunity with Verificient Technologies as a Robotics Solution Associate .
